BotGuardProof.description:
Client-side metadata attached to form submissions for enhanced
session integrity verification.

website.description: Optional referral or profile URL associated with the submission.

BotSignals.description:
Client-collected signals for bot scoring at the `/challenge/identifier` step.

All fields are `Option` — absent fields are silently skipped during scoring.
The struct is designed so that a minimal client (curl, legacy SDK) can omit
everything without being penalised: only _present_ signals contribute to the score.

auto_chrome_driver_injected.description: True if chromedriver signature properties were found on window/document.

auto_chrome_runtime_missing.description: True if chrome object is present but chrome.runtime is missing (headless artifact).

auto_chrome_spoofed.description: True if window.chrome is absent or spoofed with non-native descriptors on Chrome UA.

auto_global_tools_detected.description: True if global variables injected by Selenium, Playwright, Cypress, etc. were found.

auto_iframe_webdriver.description: True if a dynamically spawned clean iframe leaks navigator.webdriver === true.

auto_native_function_spoofed.description: True if common native functions like permissions.query have spoofed toString signatures.

auto_plugins_inconsistent.description: True if navigator.plugins is inconsistent (e.g. empty on desktop or fake instance).

auto_ua_data_inconsistent.description: True if navigator.userAgentData and User-Agent headers contradict each other.

auto_webdriver_spoofed.description: True if navigator.webdriver getter signature has been spoofed.

canvas_hash.description: SHA-256 hex of a deterministic canvas draw. Used for headless detection.

caret_at_end.description: True if the caret was positioned at the end of the email string.

email_focus_before_value.description: True if focus occurred before the email field was populated.

email_had_focus.description: True if the email field received a focusin event before form submission.

event_cascade.description:
Bitfield of observed submit events (5 bits):
bit 0 = pointerdown, 1 = mousedown, 2 = pointerup, 3 = mouseup, 4 = click.

event_order_valid.description:
True if events arrived in the correct order (pointerdown → click).
None if no pointer events were observed.

font_count.description: Number of system fonts available (out of a fixed test set of 20).

kb_dwell_mean.description: Mean of key dwell times in milliseconds.

kb_dwell_variance.description: Variance of key dwell times in milliseconds (keydown → keyup duration).

kb_flight_mean.description: Mean of key flight times in milliseconds.

kb_flight_variance.description: Variance of key flight times in milliseconds (keyup → next keydown).

kb_sample_count.description: Number of keystroke pairs sampled for biometrics.

keyboard_submit.description:
True if the form was submitted via keyboard (Enter), not a click.
Used to adjust event_cascade expectations.

mouse_event_count.description: Number of mousemove events recorded before form submission.

mouse_path_length.description: Total euclidean distance travelled by the mouse cursor in pixels.

mouse_variance.description: Variance of mouse acceleration vectors (higher = more human-like).

raf_variance.description: Variance of requestAnimationFrame deltas in milliseconds.

scroll_event_count.description: Number of scroll events observed on the login page.

scroll_speed_variance.description: Variance of scroll speed (pixels per millisecond) across all scroll events.

speech_voices_count.description: Number of voices returned by `speechSynthesis.getVoices()`. -1 = unavailable.

storage_ok.description: True if localStorage is readable and writable.

submit_visible.description:
True if the submit button was visible (IntersectionObserver).
None if IntersectionObserver is unsupported.
